content: For this user's self-hosted DuckDNS + reverse proxy stack, public access errors (e.g. 502) should first be debugged by confirming local service liveness on the target port; if the local service is confirmed running, the issue is far more likely to lie in the public entry to local service链路 (reverse proxy config, DuckDNS resolution, port forwarding/NAT) rather than the local service itself.
